name: 再现天涯
group_note: 再现天涯 (in-game banner: 梦回天涯 / 'Dream Return to Tianya'). Unrelated to the Doing-lineage 'hell' family processed earlier this session -- an independent ES-derived codebase, but with a nested wizard home directory (u/zjb/) containing multiple stale backup copies of core system files (logind.lpc, master.lpc, securityd.lpc) that are NOT referenced by any live path (LOGIN_D=/adm/daemons/logind, MASTER_OB=/adm/obj/master per include/globals.h and config.fluffos) -- confirmed via grep that nothing outside u/zjb/ references those backup copies, so only the two live files were touched; the backups were left untouched as inert dead code. WASM pass fixed: (1) A pre-existing (not introduced by this pass) boot-blocking compile error in the LIVE adm/daemons/logind.lpc: a stray leading ':' before 'string *banned_id = (...)' at line 28 produced 'error: modifier list may not be empty', which failed logind's compile entirely and disconnected every connecting user via new_conn_handler -- removed the stray colon. (2) check_legal_name()'s §8.1 GBK byte-range/parity bug: strlen bounds not halved (<4||>8 for a nominal '2 to 4 Chinese characters' -> fixed to <2||>4) and an i%2==0 parity gate that, combined with a single-codepoint is_chinese(name[i..<0]) helper, only validated every OTHER character was Chinese -- removed the parity gate so every character is checked. is_chinese() itself (adm/simul_efun/chinese.lpc) was already correct (checks str[0] as a per-codepoint 0x4e00-0x9fff range) and needed no fix. (3) master.lpc (adm/obj/master.lpc) valid_read()/valid_write() missing the standard 'user == this_object()' guard -- added to both. Confirmed NOT needed here: is_killing() (feature/attack.lpc) already takes an object parameter and every call site already passes an object -- no §7.50 type-mismatch bug exists in this lib. httpd.lpc, dns_master.lpc (via inetd.lpc), versiond.lpc, and closed.lpc all have real un-gutted socket_*() calls but NONE of them are in adm/etc/preload nor reachable from the login/registration path (VERSION_D and CLOSED_D are called from each other and from a handful of NPCs/cmds, all themselves unreachable at boot) -- left untouched as fully dormant, matching the established ftpd/dns_master precedent elsewhere in this project; confirmed via grep that no preloaded daemon or logind.lpc references any of them. log/nosave/ directory was missing (used by many non-boot-path features -- shell logging, crafting logs, item-eating logs) -- created it as a precaution though it was not boot-blocking here (logon()'s own log_file() calls are all to non-nosave paths). Admin seeded: fluffos (boss) in adm/etc/wizlist (this lib's top wizard rank string is '(boss)', not '(admin)' -- alongside the archive's pre-existing tangsheyu/baizhou/bzhou/baixzhou entries). Registration verified end-to-end pre- and post-formatter (English id -> y confirm -> single Chinese full name (2-4 chars, no surname/name split) -> admin password + confirm -> login password + confirm -> attribute-gift menu (0 for random) + confirm -> email address -> gender -> enters 有间客栈), admin permission confirmed via '您目前权限：(boss)'. One formatter blind-spot #3 hit (d/city/sj.lpc, pre-existing unbalanced quote causing CJK-respacing corruction) -- reverted via git checkout, confirmed the '\ n' signature was absent from the pre-format blob. LPC formatter run across all 13193 .lpc files (13067 written, 80 pre-existing errors, 46 unchanged, including the many dead files under u/zjb/). No :: parent-call split hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates.
